{{Quote|What are we going to do? Those snub fighters are faster than we are!|Ania Solo|<ref name="Legacy 3" />}}
A '''class of starfighter''' was used by the [[Shifala]]n government of the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[138 ABY]]. [[Ania Solo]] ran afoul of them several [[Time/Legends|times]] during the [[Carreras Incident]].
